title: Only with the system
summary: Only with the system: the 72px claim “Some parts only work with the whole system running.”, then one plain paragraph naming the four pieces that come only with the full install and that a single project carries no retainer.

reference.borrowed: A statement over a row of four short notes.
reference.kelwin: Single-voice claim (the light accent stays in the h1); no rules, codes or drawing.

motion: entrance: the claim rises, the four pieces rise left to right.
reduced motion: final state at once.
notes: Coherence pass (round 9): see summary. Coherence pass 3: claim recast — “The loop that connects the parts is not sold in pieces.” repeated GTM Intelligence's h1 frame and was a clipped pair — and stepped from 96 to 72 (at 1024 it outranked the h1). Final check (verify r3): the paragraph opened “Four of them come only with the full install …”, which read as a subset of the claim's “some parts”; it now opens plainly: “Four parts come only with the full install: the Orchestration Rules, narrative resonance testing, the quarterly calibration with its Rebuild Sequence, and the operating retainer.”
